description:
Rectangle Copy lets you select and copy a rectangular area of a web page – something normal text selection can’t do.

Hold Alt and drag with the mouse. A rectangle appears and what will be copied is highlighted. Release the mouse – the text is already in your clipboard.

• Tables: copy whole cells, e.g. just one column (prices, names, codes) without the rest of each row. Merged cells are handled correctly and hidden rows are skipped.
• Everything else: the text inside the rectangle is copied line by line, like block selection in code editors. Indentation in code is kept.
• Columns separated by tabs (paste straight into Excel or Google Sheets) or aligned with spaces (for Notepad and plain text).
• The page scrolls by itself near the edge of the window. Esc cancels.
• Choose the key (Alt, Alt + Shift or Ctrl + Alt) and turn the extension off on sites where you don’t need it.
• Available in English, Polish, German, French, Italian, Spanish and Ukrainian.

Privacy: everything happens on your computer. The extension collects no data, shows no ads and makes no network requests. The code is open source (MIT): https://github.com/pitprivel/rectangle-copy

Rectangle Copy is free. If it saves you time, you can buy me a coffee: https://buycoffee.to/puzzelki-po-godzinach
